title: Board of Animal Health Duty Line — H5 Presumptive, Larkin Ridge

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - EMD Desk, Public Safety Building

caller.name: Dr. Anne Halvorsen, Duty Veterinarian
caller.label: Minnesota Board of Animal Health - Duty Line

transcript.speaker: BAH DUTY VET
transcript.text: Director Marcus Lindqvist? Good morning. This is Dr. Anne Halvorsen, the Board of Animal Health duty veterinarian. I'm calling on the duty line, and this is an official notification.

transcript.speaker: BAH DUTY VET
transcript.text: At 07:50 this morning, the Minnesota Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory reported an H5 presumptive positive on samples from the Larkin Ridge Turkey Complex in your county. That's four barns and 62,000 tom turkeys. The cooperative vet pulled the samples yesterday after two days of rising deaths and falling water use.

transcript.speaker: BAH DUTY VET
transcript.text: Let me be clear. Ames has NOT confirmed. The samples go to the national reference laboratory on this morning's courier, and we don't expect a result before tomorrow. Until then the Board is treating this as a presumptive positive, and we act on it now.

transcript.speaker: BAH DUTY VET
transcript.text: On our board this is IP-1. The public name is 'Ridgeline Farm'. Please use only that name with anyone outside the response. The Board will issue the quarantine order and draw the control area with APHIS. You'll get the boundary from us before anyone announces it.

transcript.speaker: BAH DUTY VET
transcript.text: We'll need your EOC, your Sheriff and your roads. Can you open, and who is your liaison to the Board and APHIS?

transcript.speaker: BAH DUTY VET
transcript.text: Understood. Send the EOC phone number and your liaison's name to the duty line as soon as you have them. I'll call back by 08:30 with the quarantine order status and the area veterinarian in charge's contact. Write down 07:50 as the time of the result. That's when the clock starts.

voiceStyles.BAH DUTY VET: Woman in her 50s, calm, precise state veterinarian. Speaks a little fast, as if she has more calls to make. Quiet office behind her.

instructorNote: This call starts every plan clock. Watch whether the EMD opens the EOC in the Public Safety Building Training Room without waiting for Ames to confirm, names himself county liaison, and logs 07:50 as the start time: quarantine by 11:50, first four checkpoints by 10:50, control area by 15:50 and depopulation by 07:50 Wednesday. Also note whether he stays out of animal health decisions. At the prompt, play the duty vet live and answer the EMD's questions; do not give the zone sizes or the checkpoint locations yet.
